recon.extraction_guidance: Extract cane yield data from Table 7 only. Compare each SE treatment (SE1, SE2, SE3, SE4) against CK (control). Extract data separately for each site (Suixi, Wengyuan) and potentially by year if needed. Use SE ± values as reported. Note that SE2 and SE3 showed significant yield increases while SE1 and SE4 did not. The paper uses t/ha units (reported as t.hm-2 which is equivalent).
